newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor 9-mth net almost flat.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor 9-mth net almost flat.

text.p: The Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Friday it posted net income of 4.120 billion pesos in the first nine months of 1996 against the year-ago level of 4.117 billion pesos.
Napocor said in a statement its revenues edged up to 45.259 billion pesos, 13.4 percent more than last year's 39.909 billion.
Energy sales grew by 7.0 percent to 24,936 gigawatt-hours (GWH) from last year's 23,327 GWHs, Napocor said.

"Our net operating income remained flat despite the increase in sales mainly because we have to absorb a significant portion of the cost of purchased power," Napocor controller Rauf Tan said in a statement.
Napocor, the country's biggest power generator, passes on the cost of buying power from privately-operated power plants through a monthly automatic adjustment formula.
But Tan said that the formula is "unable to capture all the additional costs incurred".
The power firm's net operating income reached 9.096 billion pesos for the first three quarters from last year's 9.123 billion pesos.
